title: Doukyuusei: if
overview:
That summer love I still can't forget -.

Memories of boyhood that stay in your heart forever. "Doukyuusei if", a sweet, bittersweet, and slightly adult summer story, arrives on the Sega Saturn!

Doukyuusei if is a comedic coming-of-age romance adventure. You play Takurou, an easygoing underachiever with mostly absent parents, who has three weeks of his final high school summer vacation to find a girlfriend - and he is not the only one trying. Walk around town from an overhead view, then switch to a first-person view to examine things and talk with the people you meet. Every girl has her own habits, haunts and worries, turning up in particular places at particular times, and each visit uses up part of the vacation, so plan your days carefully.

- Voice acting and additional characters
- Single player
- Memory backup save
- Shuttle Mouse compatible
- Rated for ages 18 and over

今も忘れないあの夏の恋―。

いつまでも胸に残る少年の日の思い出。甘く、切なく、ちょっぴりアダルトな夏物語『同級生if』。セガサターンに登場！
